name: TXO option liquidity and microstructure contract
coreFindings: TAIFEX option-series liquidity reference uses open interest relative to recent 5-day average volume; it is a turnover/liquidation-capacity proxy, not direct bid-ask liquidity.

TAIFEX multidimensional time-weighted best-spread/depth disclosure identified in the official liquidity page applies to Taiwan stock-index futures; it does not prove an equivalent historical TXO quote archive.
Daily option OHLC/volume/OI cannot reconstruct intraday bid-ask, depth, quote continuity, effective spread or impact.
Friday-expiry TXO introduced in 2025 creates an expiry-calendar regime break that must be versioned.
dailyDataGuard: Never synthesize historical intraday option spread/depth/quote continuity from daily OHLC, volume or OI.
primaryResearchRole: Evidence-quality dependency for IV, skew/term structure and gamma before directional alpha.
marketMakerGuard: Program/presence does not prove realized executable liquidity; absent observed quote evidence => UNKNOWN.
falsification: OI/ADV5 versus actual quote spread/depth when Tier B exists
